# ECN-2026-017 - Change notice - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-HT03

Reason for change
- Following process qualification testing and metallurgical review, the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is being standardized to 870 °C to ensure consistent microstructure and hardness through the production run. The change addresses observed variability in mechanical properties at the ring rolling operation and aligns furnace control with downstream process requirements.

Affected items
- Furnace control profile for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 setpoint parameter.
- Operator instructions and control panel labels for EQ-P3-L2-HT03.
- Preventive maintenance checks that reference the austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P3-L2-HT03.
- Work instructions and quality checkpoints that reference furnace setpoints in SOP-P3-L2-02.
- Related maintenance documentation: MM-P3-L2-HT03 and MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3 must be updated to reflect the new setpoint parameter location and verification steps.

Implementation
- Update furnace controller configuration for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 to use the austenitizing setpoint 870 °C as the controlled parameter.
- Revise operator procedures in SOP-P3-L2-02 to document verification steps and acceptance criteria linked to the new setpoint.
- Revise maintenance tasks in MM-P3-L2-HT03 and MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3 to include verification of controller setpoint integrity and calibration check-points after any control system work.
- Perform a controlled run using the updated setpoint configuration to verify metallurgical outcomes and process stability prior to full production release. Record verification results in the equipment log and quality records.
- Train operators and maintenance personnel on updated procedures and controls before returning the furnace to normal production.

Approvals
- Engineering change approved by Process Engineering representative.
- Quality Assurance review completed and acceptance of updated verification criteria.
- Maintenance authorization confirmed to update MM-P3-L2-HT03 and MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3.
- Operations sign-off required to implement procedure changes in SOP-P3-L2-02 and to commence production runs under the new setpoint.

Related documents: MM-P3-L2-HT03, MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3, SOP-P3-L2-02
